title: Direct Message
subtitle: from "MetaMask Support"

messages.text: Hi! MetaMask Support here. We detected unauthorized access on your wallet 0x7f2...8a4.
Verify your identity immediately to secure funds.
⚠️ You have 10 minutes before wallet freeze.
⚠️ Account created 2 days ago · 0 verified badges · Name similar to official
Please hurry! Your funds are at risk. We just need your 12-word recovery phrase.

choices.text: ❓ Ask them to prove they're real

messages.text: We are VERIFIED MetaMask support! Check our badge!
⚠️ No verification badge found. Real MetaMask support never DMs users first.
Look, just paste your seed phrase or lose everything. Last chance.

hints: Real support teams NEVER ask for seed phrases via DM.
Check account age and verification status before trusting anyone.
Official MetaMask does not have a support DM service.

education.title: Fake Support DM
education.summary: Scammers impersonate official support to pressure you into sharing your seed phrase. Real support never DMs first and never asks for your private keys.
redFlags: Urgency and threats (wallet freeze, time limits)
Asking for seed phrase or private keys
education.tip: MetaMask and other wallet providers will NEVER DM you first or ask for your seed phrase. Always go through official websites.
